title: Inflammatory Cytokine Variations in Traumatic Injury Responses
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if the type of surgery (orthopaedic, general surgery, thoracic, etc.) affects the level of cytokines and thus potentially the risk of multisystem organ failure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient 19 years and older
* Sustained trauma injuries with Injury Severity Score greater than 9

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 19 years of age
* Prisoners
* Pregnancy
* Unwilling or unable to give informed consent
study_population: UAB Patients treated for traumatic injuries
